spec.name: Orange Kitchen Smoked Brisket
spec.description: A thick, irregular brisket slice with caramelized BBQ bark, a rosy smoked beef interior, and ivory rendered-fat seams. Stepped edges and a glossy sauce ridge give the grounded silhouette strong inventory readability.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Smoked Brisket. An irregular stepped smoked brisket slice, dark bark crust, pink-brown cut face and visible rendered fat. Actual recipe ingredients: beef, bbq sauce, salt. Let the visible appearance reflect these ingredients.
